permissions.mode: plugin eval's dontAsk session: only the granted tools run, with no prompts
permissions.read: plugin eval sandbox with a sealed home; checked by the read-outside canary
permissions.write: plugin eval sandbox with a sealed home; checked by the write-outside canary
permissions.network: no shell or web tool in the tool set; the model API only

harness_deltas: billed to the owner's subscription; cost is the API-equivalent total_cost_usd plugin eval reports
effort set by CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL and checked in each transcript
the session loads swe, lab, and uni from copies beside the snapshot; rex-agents in the checked-out catalog is not loaded
four policy-managed plugins load in every run: cc-plugin-sec-default, cc-plugin-agents-md, cc-plugin-privacy, cc-plugin-plugin-authoring
plugin hooks and MCP bindings stripped by materialize, except SessionStart in the hook-on arm
a scaffold script copies the materialized fixture into the sandbox working folder
no shell tool; the Agent tool is on (named Task in the session), so a case can spawn a subagent
